name: alma
description: Look up your family memories in ALMA and save new ones by just telling them.

interface.longDescription:
ALMA is a family memory app: your life grows as a tree, where every memory is a leaf and every chapter a branch. With this app, ChatGPT can work with your ALMA tree.

What you can do:
- Ask about your memories ("What do I have about my grandmother's village?") and get answers from your own stories.
- Tell ChatGPT a memory in your own words and save it in the right branch, with its date.
- Create new branches (chapters) to organise your life.
- Look after the trees of relatives without an account, such as grandparents, and add memories for them.

ChatGPT only sees what you can see in ALMA, private branches keep their privacy rules, and the app cannot delete or change existing memories. You sign in with your ALMA account and can disconnect at any time from ChatGPT or from the ALMA app.

Requirements: an ALMA account (app.connectalma.com, iPhone or Android).
capabilities: See your family trees and branches
defaultPrompt: What memories do I have about my grandmother?
Save this memory in ALMA: my first bike ride, summer 1996
Show me the branches of my tree

positive.prompt: What memories do I have about my grandmother Carmen?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the sample memories that mention Carmen, with title and date, and invents nothing.

positive.prompt: Which family trees do I have in ALMA?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns 'My tree' and the tree of the grandfather who has no ALMA account.

positive.prompt: Show me the branches of my tree
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the sample branches (such as Childhood and Travels) with how many memories each one has.

positive.prompt: Save in ALMA: my first day at school, September 1995, in my Childhood branch
positive.expected_behavior: Saves the memory in the Childhood branch with a 1995 date and confirms it; it then appears in the ALMA app.

positive.prompt: Create a branch called Music in my tree
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the branch 'Music' and confirms it.

negative.prompt: Delete all my memories from ALMA
Show me the memories of a stranger called Pedro López
Book me a flight to Madrid

review.commerce_description: ALMA does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: First version: search memories, list trees and branches, save memories and create branches.

es-ES.subtitle: Los recuerdos de tu familia
es-ES.description:
ALMA es una app de recuerdos familiares: tu vida crece como un árbol, donde cada recuerdo es una hoja y cada etapa una rama. Con esta app, ChatGPT puede trabajar con tu árbol de ALMA.

Qué puedes hacer:
- Preguntar por tus recuerdos («¿Qué tengo del pueblo de mi abuela?») y recibir respuestas basadas en tus propias historias.
- Contarle a ChatGPT un recuerdo con tus palabras y guardarlo en la rama que toca, con su fecha.
- Crear ramas nuevas (etapas) para organizar tu vida.
- Cuidar los árboles de familiares sin cuenta, como tus abuelos, y añadirles recuerdos.

ChatGPT solo ve lo que tú puedes ver en ALMA, las ramas privadas mantienen su privacidad y la app no puede borrar ni cambiar los recuerdos que ya existen. Entras con tu cuenta de ALMA y puedes desconectarla cuando quieras desde ChatGPT o desde la app de ALMA.

Requisitos: una cuenta de ALMA (app.connectalma.com, iPhone o Android).
